Job Summary

This position responsible to monitor equipment health status and provide technical support to ensure successful implementation of PdM execution on site area. This position also coordinate, monitor, and product analytical report of each site equipment health while liase with OEM dealers and 3rd party vendors for technical support, regular condition monitoring, and contamination control audit to ensure sustainability of improvement initiatives.

Job Responsibilities

Key
Metric

Follow all safety awareness and maintain compliance with PTP company regulation, PTP Golden Rules, safety procedures and environmental policies
Safety procedures and rules are all successfully followed and maintained.

Maintain and control equipment health data collection compliance (online and offline data) and also updates of NDT inspections (Swing Bearing, Undercarriage, Bucket, Dump Body, Chassis/ Frame)
Equipment health data collection compliance (online and offline data) and also updates of NDT inspections (Swing Bearing, Undercarriage, Bucket, Dump Body, Chassis/ Frame) are accurately maintained and controlled.

Regular review and analyze machine electronic data (Oil, Coolant, Grease, Magnetic plugs, Filter cut analysis) with recommendation action and report
Recommendation action and report regarding machine electronic data are successfully provided.

Actively liaise and involve with PdM team on analysis and recommendation follow-ups; PdM WO creation, execution priority and quality, action feedback follow-ups
PdM is thoroughly involved to execute priority and quality.

Maintain and actively implement SHE programs and responsibility (involve identify, mitigate and monitor SHE risk), including SHE Management System to ensure the effectiveness of the programs conform to official standard, requirements and procedure applied and to confirm the execution of the SHE Responsibility meet the intended outcome
- SHE risk well maintained

- Target Zero LTI

- SHE Management System meets the current ISO 14001, ISO 45001, SMK3 & SMKP standards and requirements

Education

Diploma Degree of Engineering

Skill, Knowledge, and Experience

• Min. 3 years experiences in mining industry and equipment health initiatives.
• Advanced knowledge in maintenance analytical tools (VIMS, VHMS, ET, MPro, Insite)
• Advanced knowledge of fluid and grease analysis methods (for oil, fuel, coolant, grease)
• Advanced knowledge in mechanical awareness
• Advanced understanding of heavy equipment maintenance management
• Understand material mechanical properties (basic metallurgy, mechanical failure analysis)
• Proficient lateral and analytical thinking
• Multivariate data analytical capability
• High communication skills
• Fluent in English, both spoken and written is an advantage

Certification

• If candidates do not meet the requirements specified in the Education section, evaluation shall be conducted in accordance with KKNI Level 5.

Other Requirements

• SKK Supervisor Konstruksi Jenjang 7 (PUPR)
• BNSP Teknisi Konstruksi Senior

wo-jpfa-JR5162.d:
Job Summary**

PT Multi Farmindo Jaya is seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Sales Executive to drive revenue growth and expand our market presence. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, managing relationships with existing clients, and promoting our high-quality animal feed and agri-food products. This position requires a proactive professional who can align sales strategies with the company's commitment to nourishing emerging nations.

Job Responsibilities**

* Identify, prospect, and secure new business opportunities to achieve and exceed sales targets.
* Maintain strong, long-term relationships with existing distributors, farmers, and business partners.
* Conduct regular market visits to understand customer needs, gather competitor intelligence, and identify market trends.
* Present, promote, and sell PT Multi Farmindo Jaya product portfolio by highlighting product value and benefits.
* Negotiate contracts, pricing, and payment terms in accordance with company policies.
* Coordinate with the technical support and logistics teams to ensure timely delivery and excellent customer service.
* Prepare and submit regular sales reports, forecasts, and market analysis to the Sales Manager.

Job Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Animal Husbandry, Veterinary Medicine, Agribusiness, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Minimum of 2–3 years of proven experience as a Sales Executive, preferably within the livestock, animal feed, or poultry industry.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills.
* Result-driven mindset with a track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets.
* Willingness to travel frequently to various regions to meet clients and explore market opportunities.
* Possession of a valid driver’s license (SIM A and/or SIM C).
* Fluency in Indonesian; basic proficiency in English is an advantage.




JAPFA is an agribusiness company that engages mainly in the production of animal feed, poultry breeding, commercial farm, consumer products, aquaculture, and beef cattle farming. Founded in Indonesia and now headquartered in Singapore, we employ over 37,000 people across an integrated network of modern farming, processing and distribution facilities in Indonesia, Vietnam, India, Myanmar, and Bangladesh. We believe our people are the key to staying ahead, and we continuously seek talented individuals to grow with us and contribute to our mission.

Visit our official webpage:
https://www.japfa.com/
https://www.japfacomfeed.co.id/

wo-klbf-JR26_001473.d:
Founded in 1966, Kalbe Farma (Kalbe) is the largest publicly-listed pharmaceutical company in Southeast Asia. As of end 2023, Kalbe’s extensive healthcare ecosystem encompasses a network of 47 companies, including subsidiaries, joint ventures, and associates, all driven by a dedicated workforce of 16,795 employees.

Guided by a vision to become the country’s best global healthcare company, Kalbe offers a comprehensive healthcare solution through its four key business divisions: prescription pharmaceuticals, consumer health, nutrition, and distribution & logistics. Within these divisions, Kalbe manages a diverse portfolio reinforced by a robust distribution network that serves over one million outlets across Indonesia’s vast archipelago.

On the international stage, Kalbe has established a strong presence in ASEAN countries, as well as regions spanning East and South Asia, the Middle East, and Africa. Kalbe’s business ventures are supported by best in- class research and development capabilities, developed through strategic alliances with many international partners. The Company is deeply involved in cutting-edge areas such as drug delivery systems, cancer treatment, stem cell research, and biotechnology.

Job Description

- Develop and maintain client relationships.
- Execute sales plan of actions as deployed from superior on monthly and quarterly basis (include plan of customer visit, expenses, sales target per outlet/customer, etc).

- Mengembangkan dan mempertahankan hubungan dengan klien.
- Melaksanakan rencana aksi penjualan yang diberikan oleh atasan secara bulanan dan triwulanan (termasuk rencana kunjungan pelanggan, pengeluaran, target penjualan per outlet/pelanggan, dll).

Company:
KF PT. Kalbe Farma Tbk.
